summary: Phase 7 testing — Public Storefront Polish + Webstores Audit Trail. Backend: 21/21 tests PASS. Frontend: all 7 features verified after fixing a critical auth bug in Storefront.js (wrong localStorage key for admin token). One pre-existing backend 500 bug on GET /api/products (from iteration 157 test data) documented. All Phase 7 features confirmed working.

minor.issue: Returns 500 ResponseValidationError. Root cause: test product 'TEST Iter157 Product' (id: prod_iter157_e5d99651) in the products collection is missing required 'base_cost' field. Pydantic response model requires base_cost. This causes the Webstores admin 'Products' tab to fail loading products entirely. Pre-existing from iteration 157.

status_changed events in webstore_stage_events store 'to_status' as Python enum repr string 'WebstoreStatus.PENDING' instead of clean value 'pending'. Root cause: update_data uses model_dump() which returns WebstoreStatus enum objects, and str(enum_obj) gives enum repr. Fix: use new_status.value or str(new_status.value). The 'from_status' is stored correctly as a plain string.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED in this iteration: Admin preview showed 401 because Storefront.js used localStorage.getItem('token') but the admin token is stored under key 'auth_token' (via authStorage.js). Fixed by importing and using getAuthToken() from '../lib/authStorage'.

action_items: Fix GET /api/products 500: product 'TEST Iter157 Product' (id: prod_iter157_e5d99651) is missing base_cost field in MongoDB. Either (a) add base_cost: 0 to that document in the products collection, or (b) make base_cost Optional[float] in the Product model.

Fix status_changed event to_status enum repr: in update_webstore() at line 2302, change str(new_status) to str(new_status.value if hasattr(new_status, 'value') else new_status) to store clean string like 'disabled' not 'WebstoreStatus.DISABLED'.
critical_code_review_comments: Storefront.js used hardcoded localStorage key 'token' instead of the centralized authStorage helper getAuthToken() — this is a subtle forward-compat bug. Any future token-key changes would silently break admin preview again. All localStorage token access should go through authStorage helpers.
webstore_stage_events 'to_status' stores enum repr not value — easy fix, but worth fixing for queryability of the audit collection.
GET /api/products 500 from stale test data: consider adding 'base_cost: Optional[float] = None' with a @validator or computed default so missing base_cost doesn't crash the entire list endpoint.

preview-store-btn is in 'Settings & Branding' tab (not 'Dashboard') — this is correct but note that admins must navigate to that tab to find the preview button. Consider surfacing it in the Dashboard tab as well for discoverability.

rca_of_the_issue: Admin preview 401: Storefront.js independently managed auth with localStorage.getItem('token') hardcoded. The app uses authStorage.js (AUTH_KEY='auth_token') for all auth token storage since the auth migration. When admin logs in, token is set via setAuthToken(token, persistent=true) to localStorage['auth_token']. Storefront.js reads localStorage['token'] (wrong key) → gets null → fetch has no Authorization header → backend returns 401. Fix: use getAuthToken() from authStorage.js which correctly reads auth_token key from localStorage or sessionStorage.
